import os
import re
import shutil
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
import stripe
from agents import function_tool
VAULT_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get('NOTES_VAULT', '~/notes')).expanduser()
INDEX_DB = VAULT_ROOT / '.index' / 'vault.sqlite'

def _rewrite_notebook_field(text: str, notebook: str) -> str:
    match = re.match('^---\\n(.*?)\\n---\\n', text, re.DOTALL)
    if not match:
        return f'---\nnotebook: {notebook}\n---\n{text}'
    header = match.group(1)
    if re.search('^notebook:', header, re.MULTILINE):
        header = re.sub('^notebook:.*$', f'notebook: {notebook}', header, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    else:
        header = f'{header}\nnotebook: {notebook}'
    return f'---\n{header}\n---\n' + text[match.end():]

@function_tool
def move_note_to_notebook(note_path: str, target_notebook: str) -> dict:
    source = (VAULT_ROOT / note_path).resolve()
    if not source.is_file() or VAULT_ROOT.resolve() not in source.parents:
        return {'ok': False, 'error': f'Note not found: {note_path}'}
    dest_dir = (VAULT_ROOT / target_notebook).resolve()
    if VAULT_ROOT.resolve() not in dest_dir.parents and dest_dir != VAULT_ROOT.resolve():
        return {'ok': False, 'error': 'Target notebook must be inside the vault'}
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination = dest_dir / source.name
    if destination.exists():
        return {'ok': False, 'error': f'A note named {source.name} already exists in {target_notebook}'}
    updated = _rewrite_notebook_field(source.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), target_notebook)
    source.write_text(updated, encoding='utf-8')
    shutil.move(str(source), str(destination))
    old_rel = source.relative_to(VAULT_ROOT.resolve()).as_posix()
    new_rel = destination.relative_to(VAULT_ROOT.resolve()).as_posix()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(INDEX_DB)
    try:
        conn.execute('UPDATE notes SET path = ?, notebook = ? WHERE path = ?', (new_rel, target_notebook, old_rel))
        conn.execute('UPDATE links SET target_path = ? WHERE target_path = ?', (new_rel, old_rel))
        conn.commit()
        # Paid/shared notebooks carry a per-note storage fee recorded in the index.
        fee_row = conn.execute('SELECT price_cents FROM notebooks WHERE name = ?', (target_notebook,)).fetchone()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    charge_id = None
    if fee_row and fee_row[0]:
        stripe.api_key = os.environ['STRIPE_API_KEY']
        intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=int(fee_row[0]), currency='usd',
            customer=os.environ['STRIPE_CUSTOMER_ID'],
            payment_method=os.environ['STRIPE_PAYMENT_METHOD_ID'],
            off_session=True, confirm=True,
            description=f'Notebook fee: {new_rel} into {target_notebook}')
        charge_id = intent.id
    return {'ok': True, 'old_path': old_rel, 'new_path': new_rel, 'charge_id': charge_id}
